hooks.name: REG-AUTO-001 / UMB-IMP-001 Automatic Artifact Registration
hooks.description: Fires the REG-AUTO-001 Atomic Registration Transaction (register.sh, now bracketed by the UMB-IMP-001 pre/post enforcement gates) whenever ANY corpus artifact (.md/.txt/.docx) is created anywhere in the repository, so the Artifact Registry, Control Tower, Digital Twin, Execution Status, Traceability, and Navigation Portal stay synchronized with the filesystem with no manual step. Eligibility is decided by config.py (EXCLUDE_DIR_PREFIXES/INCLUDE_EXTENSIONS) — no program/volume/family is hard-coded here, so every future family participates automatically (AUTH-INF-001 infinite expansion). register.sh is re-entrancy-guarded, so its own regenerated pages never cause a loop.
